svg.aria-label: chum: five rods on a pier drop baits tiled end to end over target1, a boxed stretch of a double helix lying on the seabed, while library fragments drawn as fish swim toward them; the one blue bait sits on an AluY repeat and is snagged in kelp rooted there; a per-bait.tsv card compares bait2 (gc_content 0.52, one BLAST hit, bait_score 0.98) with bait3 (gc_content 0.71, 412 BLAST hits, an AluY repeat, bait_score 0.00)

g.text: Test the bait before you cast.
five baits tiled end to end; one sits on a repeat
